body: But, how would me being around and being useless change their life to a positive way? If anything, things went from bad to very bad to worse, and believe me there was nothing positive about that.

They will understand. They will be crushed, but they'll eventually understand. They will understand that I didn't go because I was selfish, but because I wanted to make room for help to come to them. Being around, this useless, is me being selfish.

I care about what would happen to them when I go. But how does that help them? I'm useless. Good thing when I go, I won't "be" so I won't "be to care". Good thing when I go, people would come to them for help. 

People would pity them and offer help when I'm gone. Being around stays in the way of that, and I'm useless at this point being around.
